request.description: Requiere autorización de SMS (sms_authorized=1). Una sola ejecución; sin reintentos. requires: sms_authorized,phone_registered,machine_credential

exec: pm.test('A08 challenge_id UUID y expires_at', function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.data.challenge_id).to.match(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/); pm.expect(b.data).to.have.property('expires_at'); pm.variables.set('challenge_id', b.data.challenge_id); pm.variables.set('a08_keys', JSON.stringify(Object.keys(b.data).sort())); });

item.name: A09 OTP request-code no registrado (respuesta uniforme)

exec: pm.test('A09 misma forma que A08 (no enumeración)', function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(JSON.stringify(Object.keys(b.data).sort())).to.eql(pm.variables.get('a08_keys')); });

request.description: Consume un intento del challenge; ejecutar solo si Seguridad lo autoriza junto con el SMS. requires: challenge_id,machine_credential,otp_wrong_code_authorized
otp_code se inyecta en tiempo de ejecución (read -s); nunca se guarda. requires: challenge_id,otp_code,machine_credential

exec: pm.test('A10 Bearer + otp_verified + assurance_level', function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.data.token).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(b.data.token_type).to.eql('Bearer'); pm.expect(b.data.otp_verified).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b.data.assurance_level).to.eql('otp_verified'); pm.variables.set('a10_bearer', b.data.token); });

item.name: A10r Readback: Bearer emitido autoriza memberships/status

exec: pm.test('A10r status presente', function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(['none','active','expired']).to.include(b.data.status); });

request.description: expired_challenge_id: challenge previo ya expirado (fixture QA). requires: expired_challenge_id,machine_credential

item.name: A12 Bearer revocado o vencido rechazado

request.description: bearer_revoked: token de identidad sintética revocado o vencido por el operador FAMEDIC antes de la corrida (DELETE /auth/token es solo native). requires: bearer_revoked,machine_credential

exec: pm.test('B01 item_type=study y ahorro consistente', function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.data.item_type).to.eql('study'); const p=b.data.pricing; pm.expect(p.comparison_status).to.eql('available'); pm.expect(p.savings_cents).to.eql(p.public_price_cents - p.famedic_price_cents); pm.expect(p.savings_cents).to.be.above(0); pm.variables.set('b01_price', p.famedic_price_cents); });

item.name: B01r Readback listado contiene el estudio con mismo precio

exec: pm.test('B01r mismo precio en listado', function () { const b = pm.response.json(); const it=(b.data.laboratory_tests||[]).find(x=>String(x.id)===String(pm.variables.get('test_id_available'))); pm.expect(it, 'presente').to.exist; pm.expect(it.item_type).to.eql('study'); pm.expect(it.pricing.famedic_price_cents).to.eql(Number(pm.variables.get('b01_price'))); });

item.name: B02 Paquete (4965) item_type=package y composición certificada

request.description: Falla legítimamente mientras composition_status != validated (aprobación comercial pendiente). requires: package_id

exec: pm.test('B02 item_type=package', function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.data.item_type).to.eql('package'); });
pm.test('B02 composition_status=validated', function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.data.composition_status).to.eql('validated'); });

pm.test('B03 comparison_status=public_price_unavailable', function () { const b = pm.response.json(); const p=b.data.pricing; pm.expect(p.comparison_status).to.eql('public_price_unavailable'); pm.expect([null, 0]).to.include(p.public_price_cents); pm.expect(p.savings_cents).to.be.null; });

pm.test('B04 comparison_status=no_savings', function () { const b = pm.response.json(); const p=b.data.pricing; pm.expect(p.comparison_status).to.eql('no_savings'); pm.expect(p.savings_cents).to.eql(0); });

pm.test('B05 comparison_status=data_inconsistent', function () { const b = pm.response.json(); const p=b.data.pricing; pm.expect(p.comparison_status).to.eql('data_inconsistent'); pm.expect(p.savings_cents).to.be.null; });

item.name: B06r Readback carrito usa precio vigente del servidor

exec: pm.test('B06r precio = catálogo vigente', function () { const b = pm.response.json(); const it=(b.data.items||[]).find(x=>String(x.laboratory_test_id||x.laboratory_test&&x.laboratory_test.id)===String(pm.variables.get('test_id_mutable'))); pm.expect(it,'item').to.exist; const price = it.price_cents ?? it.unit_price_cents ?? it.famedic_price_cents; pm.expect(price).to.eql(Number(pm.variables.get('b06_price'))); });
pm.test('B07 basic_annual', function () { const b = pm.response.json(); const plans=b.data.plans||b.data; pm.expect(plans.map(p=>p.code||p.plan_code)).to.include('basic_annual'); });
pm.test('B08 estado esperado', function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.data.status).to.eql('none'); pm.expect(b.data.purchase_eligible).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('B09 estado esperado', function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.data.status).to.eql('active'); pm.expect(b.data.source).to.eql('individual'); pm.expect(b.data.ineligibility_reason).to.eql('membership_already_active'); });

pm.test('B10 estado esperado', function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.data.status).to.eql('active'); pm.expect(b.data.source).to.eql('sponsored'); pm.expect(b.data.ineligibility_reason).to.eql('sponsored_membership_active'); });
pm.test('B11 estado esperado', function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.data.status).to.eql('expired'); });
